text: Daihatsu Motor Co., Ltd. is fully owned by Toyota Motor Corporation: it became a wholly-owned subsidiary in August 2016.
short: Daihatsu is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Toyota Motor.

source.name: Toyota Motor Corporation: Toyota and Daihatsu to Establish 'Emerging-market Compact Car Company' on January 1
source.quote: Toyota Motor Corporation (Toyota) and its fully owned subsidiary Daihatsu Motor Co., Ltd. (Daihatsu)
